meta.name: agent-protocol
meta.description: Inter-agent communication protocol for C-suite agent teams. Defines invocation syntax, loop prevention, isolation rules, and response formats. Use when C-suite agents need to query each other, coordinate cross-functional analysis, or run board meetings with multiple agent roles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义高管级智能体间的通信协议与协作规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建需要多个C级智能体协同工作的系统
copy.tagline_en: Define communication protocols and coordination rules for C-suite agent teams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building systems where multiple C-suite agents need to collaborate

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以扮演CEO、CFO等高管角色，使用[INVOKE:角色|问题]格式互相提问，并按照固定格式回复。它还会自动遵守防循环规则，在董事会会议中执行独立分析等流程。
howto.when: 当Claude被要求进行跨部门分析、召开董事会会议，或高管角色需要互相查询数据时触发。

say.text: 请CFO分析一下Q3招聘5名工程师对现金流的影响。
say.note: Claude会以CFO角色调用数据并返回结构化分析。

say.text: 召开董事会会议，请各角色独立分析当前市场风险。
say.note: Claude会进入董事会模式，各角色独立分析后交叉验证。

say.text: CEO广播：如果我们错过融资，会有什么影响？
say.note: Claude会向所有角色广播问题，并汇总独立回复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can act as C-suite roles (CEO, CFO, etc.), query each other using [INVOKE:role|question] syntax, and reply in a structured format. It also enforces loop prevention rules and isolation during board meetings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude is asked to perform cross-functional analysis, run board meetings, or when C-suite agents need to query each other for domain-specific data.

say_en.text: Ask CFO to analyze the burn rate impact of hiring 5 engineers in Q3.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke the CFO role and return a structured analysis.

say_en.text: Run a board meeting with independent analysis of current market risks.
CEO broadcast: What's the impact if we miss the fundraise?
say_en.note: Claude broadcasts to all roles and aggregates independent responses.
